claim_checks.claim: errors_in_wrong[0] substituent_position: the alkene carbon is attached to the tetralin aromatic carbon directly adjacent to the ring-fusion carbon (C1) instead of C2
claim_checks.evidence: Wrong: the bond from the methyl-bearing alkene carbon (~1080,635) goes to the ring vertex ~(1225,730). That vertex is bonded directly to ~(1425,690), a fusion carbon that also bonds up to the top gem-dimethyl carbon (~1515,515). In the ref and the correct drawing, the attachment vertex is separated from the fusion carbon by one CH (correct: (1080,465) -> (1230,355) -> fusion (1355,430)).
